newsitem.title: USA: Catalyst agrees to redeem 1.2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Catalyst agrees to redeem 1.2 mln shares.

text.p: Catalyst International Inc said Friday it entered into a definitive agreement to redeem approximately 1.2 million shares of its common stock from Summit Ventures III LP and Summit Investors II LP of Boston.
During the past few months prior to this transaction, Catalyst had purchased approximately 235,000 shares of its common stock at prevailing under a stock repurchase program.
"We see the stock redemption at current prices as an excellent opportunity to utilize cash to increase shareholder value," said Vaemond Crane, president and chief executive officer.
Catalyst develops, markets and supports warehouse management software solutions.
